baseline.recipe: fixed original architecture/encodings; final=True everywhere; 5stoppingfolds x2encodings x3seeds=30 members
baseline.outer_application: audited exact original30-member outer predictions; no renormalisation

blending.inputs: fresh original OOF and nested-selected ridge OOF inside outer fitting partition; alpha selection excludes each predicted meta fold
blending.selection: three meta-inner cluster panels; first weight within one fold-SE of best mean inner median Spearman; zero first

residual.targets: inner-fit labels minus fresh3fold fixed-original cleanOOF inside that innerfit, excluding metaheld from gradient/stopping/selection; final targets from outer-fit cleanOOF
residual.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on residual fitting rows only
residual.selection: three meta-inner cluster panels; first correction weight within one fold-SE; zero first

specification.no_other_outer_predictions: other outer folds are never stacking inputs; assessed outer artifacts used only in final application

fit_graph.base_breakdown: 3 outer-fit OOF blocks x30 +3 meta folds x3 deeper OOF blocks x30
fit_graph.ridge_breakdown: 2 representations x3 meta folds x(3alpha x3selectionfolds +1 refit) +2x(3meta residualfits+1final)
fit_graph.reuse: outer references reused only for final assessed rows; fresh crossfits shared across both representations
fit_graph.cost: local CPU only; execution runtime measured separately; no cloud launch

specification.comparisons: both blend/residual procedures and embedding-alone versus original and competitive sequence; standalone gain and complementarity gain reported separately
specification.limitations: conditional development assessment; inner models fit fewer rows than outer application; no independent confirmation or full channel claim
